recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal
recipes.subtitle: Warm spiced oat squares with tender apple chunks for easy portioning.
recipes.description: Warm oat squares with apple and cinnamon — portioned from a 9x13 so ten firefighters get the same bowl without standing over a pot. Holds in a low oven between eaters.

recipes.title: Big-Pot Savory Oats
recipes.subtitle: One pot of savory oats with cheese, eggs, and a topping bar.
recipes.description: One big pot of savory oats with a topping bar — cheese, green onion, hot sauce, and soft eggs. Performance-minded shift fuel for crews tracking macros.

recipes.title: High-Protein Yogurt Parfaits
recipes.subtitle: Greek yogurt parfaits with granola and berries — no stove required.
recipes.description: Greek yogurt, granola, and berries layered in bowls — no stove required. Performance breakfast for crews tracking protein between training and shift.

recipes.title: Protein French Toast
recipes.subtitle: Cottage cheese and egg batter for a high-protein griddle classic.
recipes.description: French toast built with extra protein — egg-heavy batter and Greek yogurt in the mix. Training-day breakfast that still tastes like weekend French toast.

recipes.title: Protein Pancake Tray
recipes.subtitle: Protein-forward pancakes for training-day mornings.
recipes.description: Pancakes boosted with Greek yogurt or protein powder, griddled in batches and held warm. For crews who want muscle fuel without skipping breakfast.
